name: openbb_equity_revenue_geographic
description:
Revenue broken down by geographic region for one company through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.revenue_per_geography).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp only; schema default fmp, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it).
By business segment: openbb_equity_revenue_segment; another source: fmp_revenue_by_geography. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "provider": "fmp"}
